content:
sarah_cs: Hey team — customer AceroCorp (ticket #15432) says their SSO users cannot view audit logs in UI or API. UI shows "You don't have permission to view audit logs" and API returns 403.

sarah_cs: Quick repro I ran: 1) login as SSO user; 2) call API:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/logs?org=acero"
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"audit_access_denied","message":"missing.retention_entitlement"}
```

sarah_cs: Admin in their org insists user is in `audit-viewers` group and Okta claim `redwood_roles` contains `audit_viewer`. They expect read access and retention metadata.

devon_se: thanks — two things to check: (1) SSO group -> org role mapping in Redwood admin; (2) entitlements/license flags. Audit read is gated by either org entitlement or token scope. Do we have the org config?

irm_admin: Pulled AceroCorp config: `audit_suite` feature=false, license shows `retention_view=false`. SCIM mapping exists but maps `audit-viewers` -> `viewer` role (no `audit_viewer` mapping).

sarah_cs: Customer attached Okta app screenshot showing `redwood_roles` claim -> ["viewer","audit_viewer"] on the SAML assertion. They also sent a sanitized token introspect — see below.

okta-sync-bot: SCIM sync ran 2025-12-03T08:12:14Z: user jane@acero.com groups: ["employees", "audit-viewers"]. SAML assertion logged at 2025-12-03T08:12:20Z with `redwood_roles`.

devon_se: can you paste the introspect output (sanitized)? Need to confirm scopes include `audit:read` / `retention:read`. If scopes missing, our API will 403 unless org entitlement granted.

sarah_cs: Introspect (sanitized):
```
{
  "sub": "acct:jane@acero.com",
  "scopes": "openid profile email",
  "claims": {"redwood_roles": ["viewer", "audit_viewer"] }
}
```

sarah_cs: Notice no `audit:read` or `retention:read` scopes — so token lacks resource scopes. That explains 403 from API even though the claim exists.

mike_prod: product-side: behavior is: API audit listing requires either org entitlement `audit_suite` OR token with `audit:read`. If org entitlement missing, token scopes must include `audit:read`. For retention metadata we also require `retention_plus`.

compliance-ops: confirmed: retention metadata is further gated to customers with `retention_plus` add-on. Even with `audit:read`, retention fields are redacted unless entitlement present. Full denial (403) indicates entitlement gating at org-level for listing.

sarah_cs: Customer reported they never purchased retention add-on, but they expected to still see basic audit entries. They say other customers in their org can see entries. Could this be a mapping mismatch at the per-user level?

irm_admin: mapping mismatch possible — SCIM->role mapping is per-group mapping in admin console; Okta claim may show `audit_viewer` but if SCIM assigned the user the `viewer` org-role, Redwood enforces the org-role entitlements. Also there was a recent change in our SAML config where we only accept resource scopes from OIDC flows, not SAML claims, for API access. So SAML `redwood_roles` won't give `audit:read` scope.

sarah_cs: So recommended steps for customer: 1) admin to introspect token from a user (we provided the curl); 2) confirm scopes include `audit:read` OR enable `audit_suite` in org; 3) if using SAML only, update Okta app to request resource scopes or map SCIM group to org-role that has entitlement. I'll include exact commands.

support-sre: I can repro in staging if someone with compliance signs off. I can also run the same curl against staging and toggle `audit_suite` to see behavior.

compliance-ops: fine to enable on staging for 24-48h. No PII will be exported. Please log changes.

devon_se: I'll draft a short KB for support: include sample introspect command and the expected tokens. Sample introspect we expect to include:
```
{
  "sub": "acct:jane@acero.com",
  "scopes": "openid profile email audit:read retention:read",
  "claims": {"redwood_roles": ["audit_viewer"] }
}
```
If scopes missing, we call it out in the reply.

sarah_cs: I'll send the customer steps + request: screenshot of Okta claim mapping, SCIM group mapping screenshot, and the introspect response. If they can't produce `audit:read` we ask their admin to either update Okta or open sales to add audit_suite.

mike_prod: small follow-up — we should update the product docs to make SSO + token scope requirements explicit. I'll add a note to the backlog.

sarah_cs: updating ticket now and asking for the requested artifacts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Routing note: no incident opened. Reaction: :eyes:
